beats.headline: Named in the crown's warning
beats.text: Every royal in the line must kill the Sultan and every other member of the family before descending to the tenth floor.

beats.headline: Usually the first of nine out
beats.text: A talk-show host with a family stake in the matter laughs at the idea that he is one of them. Do I look like a Naga to you? By his account the Blood Sultanate is almost always the first of the nine to be eliminated, and the cat wearing its crown has been dead since the moment she put it on. He means to be on the ninth floor this season himself, as War Leader of his own family's clan.

beats.headline: A co-warlord in the succession
beats.text: Carl and Donut are co-warlords of a brand-new team, and the notice carries a note: Co-Warlord Princess Donut is a member of the royal line of succession of another team, Team #4, the Blood Sultanate. See the succession rules on how this will affect gameplay. On the walk to the stairs, Donut does not say it out loud. It is a complication. A big one.

beats.headline: A representative, not a royal
beats.text: The Sultanate's seat at the planning table goes to a big green and purple naga, four-armed, in dented plate, who is a representative rather than a member of the royal family, though his wife is in it. Donut asks whether the tiara makes them cousins. They are not cousins, he says, in or out of the game, and he is plainly suppressing a grin. Will he work for her once she kills the royal family and takes it over? If he is still alive, he will be honor-bound to follow her. Or her companion, Katia.

beats.headline: Six factions try to walk out
beats.text: Sponsor message, relayed to the crawlers. The Operatic Collective, the Blood Sultanate, the Dream, the Lemig Sortion, the Madness and one more house all abdicate their spots on the ninth floor and announce they are leaving. The request is denied. While the Earth system is in quarantine, off-boarding is suspended under Syndicate rule 470.B through 495 of the System AI Stability Addendum. The teams remain as designated. The rules must be followed.

beats.headline: The Sultana behind her veils
beats.text: Arief calls the nagas a court of assassins, not warriors; no changeling or spy has ever reached their inner sanctum, and even Juice Box will not try. Their warlord is the Sultana, in life the crown princess and daughter of the naga king, play-acting the Sepsis Whore, the sultana of the old histories who had 198 daughters before 99 sons and supposedly poisoned almost all of the sons. In the old days, her honor guard were sentenced to deferred death for looking at her. The naga team loses every season. She has never once been killed in the game.

beats.headline: Always the first to fall
beats.text: The naga castle sits about eight miles from the border, on rocky ground chosen so nobody can tunnel in from below, and strangely close to Shanty Town. Historically it is almost always the first castle to fall. But every time, by the time the invaders reach the inner sanctum, the Sultana is gone. The team still loses its throne room. Its leader has never once been captured or assassinated since she took over, and she reappears at the end, laughing and joking. Nobody knows where she hides.

beats.headline: Four of eleven
beats.text: Eleven Naga entered Faction Wars this season. To free Donut and Katia from the Sepsis Whore business, four of them must die. Princess Vinata herself. Two assistants titled Ikbal, both her cousins, one of them married to Rishi. And the head of her castle guard, another cousin, rumoured to be her lover. The other seven are friends of the royal house or executives of the marketing agency that sells Naga tourism, and are not in the line of succession. Several of those seven, by the look of things, are already dead.

beats.headline: The first of the four
beats.text: Elle's team reaches the throne room. The guards there worship Emberus, just as Carl predicted, and they die, along with one big naga who worshipped no god at all. Katia gets the notification before anyone explains it: that was one of the four. The head of the castle guard. Carl adds that he was also the sultana's real-life boyfriend, and hopes she will be upset enough to make mistakes. Three left: Vinata and the two cousins. Then Edgar reports movement in the castle, non-corporeal, coming from below and moving up.
